title: SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. translated_title: SoftModel：一种自我生长拓扑的神经模型——面向持续在役学习的受控结构增长
translated_abstract: 摘要：如今，神经系统的使用几乎总是分为两个阶段——先训练，后部署——在这种模式下，它被冻结两次：训练结束，且拓扑结构本身从来不是自由变量。我们将相反的前提作为公理——完全可塑性：模型的任何部分，包括其结构，永不被冻结——并推导出终身学习者所需的治理机制。该设计的目标场景是持续的在役学习：一个在非平稳数据流上长期运行的模型，其稳定性来自治理而非静止，其容量随需求变化。结果是一个可生长的软模型：一个结构算子代数（宽度、层次、组合、输入接口、生长循环、注意力头），每个算子在应用时精确、有预算且可审计，采用与否完全由保留的现实门控决定，该门控统一对待参数和结构变化。一个从零开始的完整系统实现了全部设想。
tldr: 本文提出一种完全可塑的神经模型，通过受控的结构增长和统一现实门控，实现持续在役学习，突破传统训练后冻结的范式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fully plastic neural model that achieves continual in-service learning via governed structural growth and a unified reality gate, breaking the traditional train-then-freeze paradigm.
